params.message:
Split the site settings into a Stories and an Algemeen tab

Pagina Stories opened the whole settings document, starting with the
brand's fallback SEO. Stories now opens on its own tab; the fallback SEO
says what it is used for and warns about Hoet in the title.

Portal: In de Studio toont Pagina Stories nu alleen wat bij Stories hoort; de andere instellingen staan onder Algemeen.
